title: Sheet-Pan Kielbasa, Cabbage & Potatoes
description: Roasted smoked sausage, cabbage wedges, and potatoes with almost no cleanup.

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan if you want easier cleanup.
Toss 1 lb halved baby potatoes with 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and a pinch of pepper. Roast 15 minutes.
Add 12 oz sliced kielbasa and 1/2 head cabbage wedges. Drizzle with the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil and season with the remaining garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Roast 18–20 minutes more, turning the cabbage once, until potatoes are tender and cabbage edges are browned.

title: Creamy Chicken & Rice Casserole
description: A cozy oven casserole using cooked chicken, rice, and a simple creamy sauce.
substitutions: Frozen mixed vegetables can replace peas and carrots.

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Stir together 3 cups cooked rice, 2 cups shredded chicken, 1 can cream of chicken soup, 1 cup milk, 1 cup frozen peas and carrots, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.
Spread the mixture in the dish and sprinkle 1 cup shredded cheddar over the top.
Bake 30–35 minutes until bubbling around the edges and hot in the center.

title: Cheesy Broccoli Rice Casserole
description: A simple meatless casserole with broccoli, rice, cheddar, and a creamy sauce.

ingredients.item: broccoli florets, cooked until just tender

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and grease a 2-quart baking dish.
Mix 3 cups cooked rice, 3 cups cooked broccoli, 1 can cream of mushroom soup, 3/4 cup milk, 1 cup cheddar, 1/2 teaspoon onion powder, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.
Spread in the dish and top with the remaining 1/2 cup cheddar.
Bake 25–30 minutes until hot and bubbling.

title: Ham & Potato Breakfast Casserole
description: An easy breakfast bake with eggs, potatoes, ham, and cheddar.

ingredients.item: frozen diced hash brown potatoes, thawed

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Spread 3 cups thawed diced hash browns and 1 1/2 cups diced ham in the dish.
Whisk 6 eggs with 1 cup milk, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Pour over the potatoes and ham.
Sprinkle 1 1/2 cups cheddar over the top and bake 35–40 minutes, until the center is set.
